V32/L24 transport preregistration, before measurements: allowed alpha1.4 datasets bg_167595 (sequence4253/table14253) and bg_3816d0 (sequence100058648240/table100058658240), train800/test200. Predict frozen SGD0 GRU CE lower than TF. Opposite finite means are counterexamples; dataset shape V32 is explicitly set, not inherited V24. This is closer to but not an exact replay of q_e8a05a (T1024/bs32, unequal decay). Block bg_167595/SGD.
